summary: This note is a Wikipedia-style biography of Steven Adler, an American musician best known as the former drummer and co-songwriter of the hard rock band Guns N' Roses. It covers his firing in 1990 over heroin addiction, his subsequent unsuccessful projects, his later bands Adler's Appetite and Adler, his reality TV appearances, and his 2012 Rock and Roll Hall of Fame induction. The text appears twice in near-identical form, with minor punctuation differences.
one_line: Steven Adler is an American drummer, former Guns N' Roses member, and later bandleader and reality TV participant.
key_facts: Steven Adler was born Michael Coletti on January 22, 1965.
Steven Adler is an American musician best known as the former drummer and co-songwriter of the hard rock band Guns N' Roses.
Adler achieved worldwide success with Guns N' Roses in the late 1980s.
Adler was fired from Guns N' Roses over his heroin addiction in 1990.
After his firing, Adler reformed his old band Road Crew and briefly joined BulletBoys, both of which proved unsuccessful.
During the 2000s, Adler was the drummer of the band Adler's Appetite.
From 2012, Adler held the drummer position in the band Adler.
In early 2017, Adler declared that the band Adler had dissolved.
Adler's stated reason for ending the band Adler was his lack of interest in performing during poorly attended concerts.
Adler appeared on the second and fifth seasons of the reality TV show Celebrity Rehab with Dr. Drew.
Adler appeared on the first season of the spin-off Sober House.
Adler was inducted into the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame in 2012 as a member of Guns N' Roses.
